assumptions: Uses the supplied falling_blocks toolkit runtime as the engine candidate rules adapter.
Task-specific gravityTicks=30 and lockDelayTicks=2 override toolkit defaults.
FPS independence is intended through a 60 Hz accumulator and is not yet measured.
Exactly one public next-piece preview is shown; remaining queue, bag, sequence and RNG state stay hidden.

Whitelisted declared falling-block gameplay fields, mapped board/gravity/lock aliases, exposed only the single configured preview through the public observation, accepted public rotate/wait/direction forms, and exposed the live fixed-step accumulator and transition log. Initial-piece shape cell-matrix adaptation is local to the adapter.
Rotation, hard drop, and hold keydown edges queue until the next 60 Hz simulation tick and are consumed once; browser key-repeat does not enqueue repeated presses.
